commands.name: note_create
commands.description: Makes a new note with a title and optional body text.

args.name: title
args.meaning: The note's first line; one non-empty line.

args.name: body
args.meaning: Text after the title; line breaks are kept.

args.name: folder
args.meaning: Folder to put it in, by exact name; None means the default folder.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: Make a note called Packing list
Write a note titled Gate code that says 4417
Add a new note to my Travel folder called Hotel with the booking number in it
Start a note named Ideas for the party
commands.precondition: Notes has a local account named "On My Mac". If folder is given, exactly one folder has that name. For ui mode, the program running Python has Accessibility and Automation permission for System Events and Notes. For background mode, it has Automation permission for Notes.
commands.postcondition: A new note holds title as its first line and body after it, in folder or the default folder. Other notes with the same title are left alone.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: title is not one non-empty line, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no folder has that exact name

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one folder has that name; nothing is changed

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Notes shows a dialog with typed text or with no Cancel button, in which case nothing is changed; or another app is in front when the call goes to type

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a screen element never appeared in time, Notes' scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

commands.name: checklist_create
commands.description: Makes a new note holding a real Notes checklist with one unchecked item per entry.

args.name: title
args.meaning: The note's first line.

args.name: items
args.meaning: The checklist items, as strings; each must be one non-empty line, and at least one is needed.

args.name: folder
args.meaning: Folder to put it in, by exact name; None means the default folder.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: "ui" or "background"; use one of this command's modes.

example_requests: Make a checklist called Groceries with milk, eggs and coffee
Create a packing checklist: boots, tent, stove
Start a to-do checklist in my Travel folder for visa, tickets and insurance
commands.precondition: Notes has a local account named "On My Mac". If folder is given, exactly one folder has that name. For ui mode, the program running Python has Accessibility and Automation permission for System Events and Notes.
commands.postcondition: A new note holds title as its first line and the items as an unchecked checklist, in folder or the default folder.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: items is empty or has an entry that is not one non-empty line, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotSupported

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no folder has that exact name

errors.name: Ambiguous

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: Notes shows a dialog with typed text or with no Cancel button, in which case nothing is changed; or another app is in front when the call goes to type

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a screen element never appeared in time, Notes' scripting failed, or the change was not seen in time

commands.name: note_attach_image
commands.description: Adds an image file to the end of a note; the file itself is left as it is.

args.name: match
args.meaning: The note's exact title.

args.name: path
args.meaning: An absolute path (or starting with ~) to a .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .heic, .tiff or .tif file.

args.name: folder
args.meaning: Only look in the folder with this name.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "background": this command has no verified ui mode.

example_requests: Add this photo to my Trip note
Attach the screenshot to the Bug notes
Put the diagram image in the Ideas note
commands.precondition: Exactly one note has that title, within folder if given. It has Automation permission for Notes.
commands.postcondition: The note ends with the image, and its text is unchanged.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: the path isn't absolute or isn't an image type, or mode is not "ui" or "background"

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no note has that title, or no file is at the path; nothing is changed

errors.name: Ambiguous
errors.when: more than one note matches; nothing is changed

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: Notes' scripting failed, or the attachment wasn't seen in time

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": this command has no ui mode

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 only, unlike this app's other commands (macOS 26.6.2), so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
The first attachment on the test VM made Notes upgrade its local store, which changes note ids.
With Notes open, its scripting can list one image twice; what was stored was checked in Notes' database.
